# Front sway bar endlink replacement

## Summary

Assemble new ball joints by connecting two steel caps with a thinner center rod. [t3213]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Remove the old front sway bar endlinks from both sides.
2. Assemble new ball joints by connecting two steel caps with a thinner center rod.

_Procedure reported by [t3213]._
